name: Raid Manager
description: ZDPS-compatible raid coordination HUD — pull countdown, raid warnings, and savable, shareable dungeon marker presets.
author: Stellar

added: Share Mark Presets with your group — Export Preset gives you a short code to copy, and Import Preset turns a pasted code into the same preset, with every step, marker and note.
Add a note to each step (for example "P2 — stack west"). It shows in the window and in the pop-up when you move to that step.
Rename a preset any time with the pencil button.
changed: The Mark Presets window is wider and easier to read.
Requires framework 2.19.0 or newer. If you're on an older framework you keep the previous version until you update.
